newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire to distribute Volvos in HK, China.
newsitem.headline: Swire to distribute Volvos in HK, China.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd said on Tuesday its newly-formed automotive subsidiary, Taikoo Motors Ltd, had signed an agreement with Jebsen & Co to acquire the distributorship of Volvo automobiles in Hong Kong and southern and central China.
Swire Pacific has been a Volvo distributor in Taiwan since 1977 and in northern and eastern China since 1993, executive director James Hughes-Hallett said in a company statement.
With the latest acquisition, the group will hold the Volvo car franchise for most of China including Hong Kong and Macau, it said.
Volvo is presently represented in Hong Kong and southern China by Cimbria Motors, a subsidiary of Jebsen & Co.
The transfer of the agency is expected to be completed by the end of June 1997, the statement said.
"Taiwan has been consistently one of the largest Volvo markets in Asia and this year, our Volvo car sales in China has enjoyed very healthy growth," Hughes-Hallett said.

"The addition of Hong Kong and South and Central China will enable Swire to enjoy synergy within its automotive division and to take advantage of the opportunities within the Greater China region," he added.
"Volvo's range of new models to be launched in Hong Kong in the coming months makes this a particularly exciting opportunity," he said, without elaborating.
